company.name: Classiq Technologies
company.shortDescription: Classiq Technologies develops automation and synthesis of quantum algorithms.
company.description: Classiq Technologies, the leading quantum software company, provides an all-encompassing software platform (IDE, compiler and OS) with a single point of entry into quantum computing, from algorithm design to execution. Tailored to all levels of developer proficiency, Classiq aims to democratize access to quantum computing with software that equips customers to take full advantage of the quantum computing revolution. A low-code development environment that automates quantum programming ensures that a broader range of talents, including those with backgrounds in AI, ML and linear algebra, can harness quantum computing without requiring deep, specialized knowledge of how to program quantum computer hardware. Classiq also works closely with advanced computation hardware providers providing software for use with quantum computers, HPC and quantum simulators. Backed by powerful investors such as HPE, HSBC, Samsung, Intesa Sanpaolo and NTT, Classiq’s world-class team of scientists and engineers has distilled decades of quantum expertise into its groundbreaking software development platform.

aiResearchSummary.text: Classiq Technologies is researching methods for processing quantum programs and optimizing quantum circuits, such as DAG-based CSP quantum circuit modeling, input-based modification of a quantum circuit, and optimizing quantum circuits with permutable input registers. They develop a graphical user interface for quantum circuit design and generating a graphical representation of a quantum circuit, while also focusing on determining and selecting physical qubits for quantum error correction schemes as key areas of research and development.
